day.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• He wakes up at 6am, roams around his village, and he take rest at around \"cold\".\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• Patient was taken to an ENT specialist who ruled him clear of any problem.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• The same day, the patient noticed an acute decrease in his defecation and micturition.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• When patient was taken to the hospital in Nakrekal where he was diagnosed with Renal failure.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• He was put on Maintainance Hemodialysis since then.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• Patient recollects that after 5 days of dialysis, patient's micturition and defecation was somewhat restored.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• Till date, patient has underwent about 15+ dialysis in the span of 2 months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• Patient was then admitted in Hyderabad as it was easier for his wife to take him to the hospital as she works there.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• However, due to financial crises, later the patient was admitted to this current hospital.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E• As of yesterday, patient complains of neck pains, but is feeling better compared to the past
